newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil jumps on Asian arb, IPE squeeze.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil jumps on Asian arb, IPE squeeze.

text.p: NWE gas oil markets received a sharp boost on Wednesday as arbitrage traders, watching strong demand in Asia, piled up length in the European market.
"The arb is open to the Far East and the Med is short of product so people are looking for product in the North," a trader said.

IPE Nov gas oil jumped $6.50 to $214.75 per tonne and Nov/Dec backwardation widened by $2.00 to $6.00 amid talk of a squeeze. Dealers said the trader who was short November IPE claimed he could deliver 600,000 tones into his position at expiry next Tuesday But the trader on the other side did not believe this to be true. "They are going totally head to head on this one," a third trader said.
One company bought 30,000 tonnes of heating oil barges at Nov IPE +50 cents fob ARA on Wednesday, to be shipped out of the area, but also secured product for Nov -50 cents.
"Amsterdam is becoming a very cheap source of supply for India and Indonesia," a trader said.
Two Russian cargoes were sold at the "mean of means" formula -$5.00/$5.50 fob Ventspils for the Asian arb.
